The *Ekadīpiyattheraapadāna* (Tha Ap 418) is a biographical verse text located in the Therāpadāna collection of the Pali Tipiṭaka [SuttaCentral]. The text recounts the past karmic deed of offering a single lamp (or light) and its resulting benefits. SuttaCentral records five translations across five languages for this entry [SuttaCentral].

In terms of parallels and text reuse, SuttaCentral lists resembling narrative parallels in the *Sivijātaka* (Ja 499) and the *Pañcadīpakattheraapadāna* (Tha-Ap 59) [SuttaCentral].
